events.title: Investigation assessment
events.detail: Checkout incident is propagating due to failures in payments and ledger. All services downstream of checkout are impacted. However, no origin diagnostics (e.g., logs, traces) are available to confirm root cause or validate any recovery action. Current policies block all recovery actions due to missing diagnostic evidence. A diagnosis is required to identify the missing evidence and confirm whether any action is justified.
